program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((sc (first (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v 4) (!= v 7))) (grid-colors g))))
                (sp (find-color g sc))
                (bb (bbox-of-cells sp))
                (sr1 (first bb))
                (sc1 (second bb))
                (sr2 (third bb))
                (sc2 (fourth bb))
                (sh (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
                (sw (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
                (yobjs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) (objects g 7)))
                (b0 (obj-bbox (first yobjs)))
                (b1 (obj-bbox (second yobjs)))
                (scc (/ (+ 0.0 sc1 sc2) 2))
                (mc (/ (+ 0.0 w) 2))
                (b0cc (/ (+ 0.0 (second b0) (fourth b0)) 2))
                (ci0 (not (= (< scc mc) (< b0cc mc))))
                (cb (if ci0 b0 b1))
                (rb (if ci0 b1 b0))
                (cbo (if ci0 (first yobjs) (second yobjs)))
                (cbs (map (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) 1000) (second p)))
                          (obj-cells cbo)))
                (ic (filter (lambda (c)
                              (let loop
                                   ((r (first cb)))
                                   (if (> r (third cb))
                                       #f
                                       (if (not (member (+ (* r 1000) c) cbs))
                                           #t
                                           (loop (+ r 1))))))
                            (range (second cb) (+ 1 (fourth cb)))))
                (rbcr (/ (+ 0.0 (first rb) (third rb)) 2))
                (cbcc (/ (+ 0.0 (second cb) (fourth cb)) 2))
                (nr (if (> rbcr (/ (+ 0.0 h) 2)) (+ 1 (- (third rb) sh)) (first rb)))
                (nc (if (> cbcc mc) (+ 1 (- (max-list ic) sw)) (min-list ic))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (if (and (>= r nr) (< r (+ nr sh)) (>= c nc) (< c (+ nc sw)))
                        (let ((sv (at g (+ sr1 (- r nr)) (+ sc1 (- c nc)))))
                          (if (= sv sc) sc v))
                        (if (= v sc) 7 v))))))
